newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks slip lower, focus remains on Mar CPI.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks slip lower, focus remains on Mar CPI.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed lower on Thursday as the market continued to consolidate recent gains. But traders said the market appeared stable at current levels.
Repsol, undergoing a public share offer this month, was one of the best performers, ending unchanged at 6,150 after hitting new highs earlier in the session.
The general index closed down 2.94 points, 0.61 percent, to 479.06, while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares slipped 38.95 points, 0.7 percent, to 5,488.29.
Dealers said all eyes remained on Spain's March CPI data due on Friday. Analysts expect a year-on-year rate of 2.4 percent or lower versus 2.5 percent in February.

"We're seeing a correction which is not worrying and which could turn around if forecasts for inflation are confirmed," one dealer said. But dealers warned that Wall Street would continue to play an influential role in the market's direction.
Turnover reached just over 57 billion pesetas with more than half attributed to trading in Telefonica and Repsol.
